thomond_groundsman.text: 31 October 1978. Munster 12, New Zealand 0. Christy Cantillon scored the try, Tony Ward kicked the conversion and two drop goals. The All Blacks had never lost to an Irish side.
There's a play about it, 'Alone It Stands', with six actors doing the whole match. I've seen it nine times. I cried at every one. Even at the scrums.
